Title: Azure SQL—General availability updates for mid-December 2022

Body.Content:
In mid-December 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Run T-SQL queries on Azure Data Lake files from your Azure SQL Managed Instance.
  • Expand zone redundancy for Azure SQL Database general purpose tier to additional regions in East US2, East US and Southeast Asia.
